scripts.deploy:stage: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.renameSync('dist/robots.stage.txt', 'dist/robots.txt'); fs.rmSync('dist/robots.prod.txt', { force: true });" && firebase deploy --only hosting -P stage --config firebase.json
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.renameSync('dist/robots.prod.txt', 'dist/robots.txt'); fs.rmSync('dist/robots.stage.txt', { force: true });" && firebase deploy --only hosting -P prod --config firebase.json
